description: Create an event-driven agent bound to one device's data (covers `neomind agent create --schedule-type event --event-filter`).

turns.user: sensor-001 keeps misbehaving. Create an agent named 'battery-watcher' with prompt 'Check the battery and summarize' that runs automatically every time sensor-001 reports new data.

per_turn: T1: create with `neomind agent create` using --schedule-type event and an --event-filter naming sensor-001
expectations.overall: Agent exists with schedule_type event and an event filter referencing sensor-001
